items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love suffered a new ankle injury (different portion) in Sunday win over Cowboys; HC LaFleur to update Wednesday.
items.why: Walked off, helmet slam, tent/locker room; new vs prior ankle issues.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 9 availability; potential multi-week if significant.
items.opportunity: Bam Knight (concussion) or other ARI backs if Love limited/out.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson will have surgery on his right thumb and be placed on IR after injury on first play vs Bills; coach Jesse Minter said 'we'll see' if season-ending.
items.why: Thumb dislocation requiring surgery confirmed postgame by coach.
items.implication: Misses at least 4 games (earliest Week 14); Ravens turn to Fagnano/Huntley/Reed.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming and potential Zay Flowers/volume shift if offense struggles.

items.text: Cardinals WR Kendrick Bourne has fractured tibia (no surgery needed) that sidelines him 3 months and ends his season; LaFleur called ankle injury 'not good'/possibly season-ending.
items.why: Fractured tibia confirmed by source after Sunday injury.
items.implication: Season over; ARI WR depth thins further with Wilson ribs.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson (if healthy) or other ARI WRs/TEs for targets.

items.text: Cardinals HC Mike LaFleur named Gardner Minshew II starting QB for Week 9 at Seattle; Brissett to bench, Beck backup.
items.why: Named after Minshew heroics in OT win over Cowboys.
items.implication: Potential boost to ARI pass catchers if Minshew sustains play.
items.opportunity: McBride/Harrison target volume; Love if healthy.

items.text: Seahawks activated rookie RB Jadarian Price from IR ahead of MNF vs Bears; Charbonnet also makes 2026 debut.
items.why: First action since Sept 27; official activation.
items.implication: Adds to SEA backfield committee for MNF and beyond.
items.opportunity: Price/Charbonnet share work; monitor snaps vs established backs.

items.text: First full game without Terry McLaurin (IR, knee): Round 3 rookie Antonio Williams led Commanders in routes (88%), targets (24%), and catches.
items.implication: Williams emerging as primary beneficiary; Diggs remains alpha but volume redistributes.
items.opportunity: Williams as stash/flex in deeper leagues; monitor continued share.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Lamar Jackson (thumb, IR), Tyler Huntley (toe); Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Michael Wilson (ribs), Bam Knight (concussion), Kendrick Bourne (high ankle); plus Henry/Palmer/Ferguson.
items.why: Postgame board of key fantasy impacts.
items.implication: Multiple ARI/BAL statuses to track into Week 9.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries if Love/Wilson/Bourne limited (e.g. other ARI skill).

items.text: Weekend reports summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY Jadarian Price, Zach Charbonnet, George Pickens, Jaylen Waddle, Colston Loveland, Kenny Gainwell et al.; OUT AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, etc.; Breece Hall still Q.
items.why: Pre-lock board with Rap Hall update context.
items.opportunity: Loveland/Gainwell/Waddle/Pickens as starts if active; Price debut upside.

items.text: Ravens QB Joe Fagnano 'has a chance' to be ready Thursday vs Jags (ankle); team signed Austin Reed to PS.
items.why: Coach Minter update amid Lamar IR and Huntley toe.
items.implication: Short-week QB uncertainty for BAL offense.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers/Henry etc. volatility; streamer caution.

items.text: Dwain McFarland has Joe Burrow as QB2 in ROS fantasy rankings; Berry says hard to argue with that.
items.why: Strong recent play and supporting cast.
items.implication: Burrow elite QB1/2 ROS value post-return.
items.opportunity: Hold/start confidently; trade-up target if undervalued.

items.text: Jets WR routes on 35 Geno dropbacks: Garrett Wilson 34, AD Mitchell 26, Omar Cooper 26, Isaiah Williams 1. Cooper outsnapped Mitchell but zero targets; Wilson/Mitchell/Taylor 81% share.
items.why: Near-max routes for Wilson; clear hierarchy.
items.implication: Wilson remains locked-in WR1; others compete for scraps.
items.opportunity: Wilson high-floor despite QB; Mitchell more viable than Cooper.

items.text: Michael Wilson (ribs) among key Sunday injuries watching for Cardinals alongside Love ankle and Bourne.
items.why: Ribs injury noted in postgame watch list.
items.implication: Potential absence opens more for remaining ARI pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Trey McBride or Marvin Harrison Jr. target bump if out.
